name: Game Boy
blurb: Nintendo's 1989 handheld with a green-tinted screen, four AA batteries and Tetris
title: Game Boy: Release Date, Price, Sales and Classic Games
description: The Game Boy is Nintendo's handheld console, released in 1989 with a green monochrome screen and Tetris. With the Color it sold about 118.69 million units.
answer: The Game Boy is the handheld game console Nintendo launched in Japan on April 21, 1989 (12,500 yen) and in North America on July 31, 1989 (about $90, with Tetris in the box). It had an unlit monochrome screen in four shades of green-grey and ran for up to about 30 hours on four AA batteries. Together with the 1998 Game Boy Color it sold about 118.69 million units before the line was discontinued in 2003; many of its games are now playable on Nintendo Switch Online.

body: The original Game Boy is a grey, upright brick: a 2.5-inch screen of 160 × 144 pixels on top, a D-pad, A and B buttons, and Start and Select below. The screen had no backlight, so you played by a window or under a lamp, and a dial on the side set the contrast. A link cable let two players connect for head-to-head Tetris or, later, Pokémon trades.

Nintendo Research & Development 1, led by Gunpei Yokoi with Satoru Okada, designed it. Choosing a cheap monochrome screen over colour kept the price low and the batteries lasting far longer than colour rivals.

body: Tetris was the pack-in game in North America and Europe but not in Japan, and it is a big reason adults bought the machine too.

Nintendo stopped making the Game Boy family in 2003, so original units come from the second-hand and collector market. Since February 2023 the base Nintendo Switch Online subscription has included a Game Boy library, starting with games such as Tetris, The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening DX, Kirby's Dream Land and Super Mario Land 2, with filters that imitate the Game Boy, Pocket and Color screens.

faq.q: When did the Game Boy come out?
faq.a: April 21, 1989 in Japan and July 31, 1989 in North America.

faq.q: How many Game Boys were sold?
faq.a: About 118.69 million Game Boy and Game Boy Color units combined.

faq.q: What batteries does the original Game Boy use?
faq.a: Four AA batteries, good for up to about 30 hours of play.
